articles.title: Cross-chain protocol Allbridge halts after $1.65 million flash loan exploit
articles.snippet: The attacker used a $1.12 million flash loan from Kamino to manipulate pool ratios, enabling them to withdraw assets at favorable rates before bridging funds.

articles.title: Vietnam sets fines for unlicensed crypto trading ahead of regulation rollout
articles.snippet: The new rules establish penalties as much as $1,900 for crypto violations, including unlicensed trading and AML breaches, ahead of Vietnam’s regulated crypto market launch.

articles.title: South Korea probed 40 cases of crypto manipulation over 2 years
articles.snippet: Financial Services Commission Chair Lee Eog-won posted the figures on the second anniversary of the enactment of the Virtual Asset User Protection Act.

articles.title: Upbit parent Dunamu faces South Korean regulator sanctions process: Report
articles.snippet: Korea’s Virtual Asset User Protection Act lacks explicit sanctions provisions for hacking and similar incidents, clouding the scope of penalties facing the Upbit operator Dunamu.

articles.title: Galaxy lands 15-year Texas Tech stadium naming rights deal
articles.snippet: Galaxy Digital will rename Texas Tech’s football stadium under a 15-year agreement, expanding its West Texas presence as the state attracts growing crypto investment.
